metadata.description: Cornell Research & Innovation Skills Hub. Plugins and skills for research administration, published by RAIS and R&I units.

plugins.name: rais-ecfr
plugins.description: Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR) for research administration: search, retrieve and compare 2 CFR 200, 45 CFR 46 and the rest, grounded in the live regulatory text.

plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Document processing skills for Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and PDF files: create, edit, and inspect spreadsheets, documents, presentations, and PDFs from Claude.

plugins.name: oria-iacuc-lay-summary
plugins.description: Helps Cornell PIs write or improve the lay summary of an IACUC animal use protocol: drafts from pasted source material, trims long summaries, and keeps track of details that belong in other protocol sections.

plugins.name: oria-rass-forms
plugins.description: Fills ORIA forms, starting with the Grant-IACUC Protocol Comparison Checklist, from a RASS record PDF and returns a finished PDF.

plugins.name: rais-kb
plugins.description: Turns a folder of your documents into a knowledge base Claude can answer questions from and, for contract review, a playbook the Legal plugin follows. Your documents stay in your folder, which can be shared through SharePoint.
